name: CTLD - Complete Troops and Logistics Deployment
summary: Lua script for troop transport, crate-based unit building, FOBs, radio beacons and JTAC auto-lasing.
description:
Loaded inside a mission with DO SCRIPT triggers after MIST. Adds helicopter and C-130 troop/vehicle transport, crate logistics, FOB construction, beacons and JTAC automation. Originally by Ciribob, now maintained by Zip and the VEAF team.

Requires: Requires MIST loaded first; beacon.ogg/beaconsilent.ogg sound files needed for beacons; optional CTLD-i18n.lua and DCS-SimpleTextToSpeech.

releases.changelog: ASC C-130J support and multiple fixes
